sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液也被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心思想要掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达（Ada）。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“案件档案呈现”（Casefile Presents）推出的全新系列，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: Early evening of August 22, 2012, the village of Steppeside, on Dublin's south side, had fallen silent and still.
sentences.zh: 2012年8月22日傍晚，都柏林南部的斯泰普赛德（Steppeside）村庄陷入了一片寂静。

sentences.en: Sheila Hawkins peered out her window to a block of apartments across the road.
sentences.zh: 希拉·霍金斯（Sheila Hawkins）透过窗户望向马路对面的公寓楼。

sentences.en: Her eyes settled on one in particular, which belonged to her stepdaughter, 36-year-old Elaine O'Hara.
sentences.zh: 她的目光锁定在其中一间公寓上，那是她继女、36岁的伊莱恩·奥哈拉（Elaine O'Hara）的住处。

sentences.en: Sheila couldn't see the inside clearly, but she could tell the lights were off and there were no signs of activity.
sentences.zh: 希拉看不清里面的情况，但她能看出灯是灭的，也没有任何活动的迹象。

sentences.en: She thought it was strange.
sentences.zh: 她觉得这很奇怪。

sentences.en: Elaine had left the family gathering hours earlier at 4pm, telling others she was going home to reSt.
sentences.zh: 伊莱恩几个小时前，也就是下午4点，离开了家庭聚会，说她要回家休息。

sentences.en: Yet, it looked as though she wasn't home at all.
sentences.zh: 然而，她看起来根本不在家。

sentences.en: Sheila assumed Elaine had gone to bed early to get a good night's sleep ahead of the Tall Ships Festival the next day.
sentences.zh: 希拉以为伊莱恩是为了第二天的高桅帆船节（Tall Ships Festival）能睡个好觉，所以早早睡下了。

sentences.en: She messaged Elaine at 10.34pm, writing,
sentences.zh: 她在晚上10点34分给伊莱恩发了条信息，写道：

sentences.en: See you at 7.15.
Elaine didn't respond.
sentences.zh: 伊莱恩没有回复。

sentences.en: Earlier that day, Sheila had offered Elaine a lift to the Tall Ships Festival.
sentences.zh: 当天早些时候，希拉曾主动提出开车送伊莱恩去参加高桅帆船节。

sentences.en: The festival ushers in historic sea vessels to Dublin's port on Ireland's east coast, for a three-day event of sailing, live music and festivities.
sentences.zh: 该节日会将历史悠久的帆船引入爱尔兰东海岸的都柏林港，举办为期三天的航海、现场音乐和庆祝活动。

sentences.en: Elaine had signed up to work as a volunteer.
sentences.zh: 伊莱恩报名担任了志愿者。

sentences.en: Having completed training and preparation, she was thoroughly looking forward to it.
sentences.zh: 在完成了培训和准备工作后，她对此充满了期待。

sentences.en: Elaine accepted Sheila's offer, grateful for the lift.
sentences.zh: 伊莱恩接受了希拉的好意，并对搭车表示感谢。

sentences.en: On the road between their apartments was a bus stop where they planned to meet the morning of the festival.
sentences.zh: 在她们公寓之间的路上有一个公交车站，她们计划在节日那天早上在那里会合。

sentences.en: From there, Sheila would drive 20 minutes north into the city, drop Elaine off at the port and continue onwards to work.
sentences.zh: 从那里出发，希拉会开车向北行驶20分钟进入市区，把伊莱恩送到港口，然后继续去上班。
随着7点15分的临近。

sentences.en: As 7.15 approached the following morning of August 23, Sheila looked outside.
sentences.zh: 随着8月23日第二天早上7点15分的临近，希拉向外望去。

sentences.en: Slow, semi-frequent traffic rolled paSt.
sentences.zh: 稀疏的车辆缓慢地驶过。

sentences.en: She scoured at the bus stop, but Elaine hadn't arrived yet.
sentences.zh: 她仔细搜寻着公交车站，但伊莱恩还没到。

sentences.en: Not a big deal, Sheila thought.
sentences.zh: 希拉心想，没什么大不了的。

sentences.en: She was probably still getting ready.
sentences.zh: 她可能还在准备出门。

sentences.en: When 7.15 came and went, Elaine's absence from the bus stop became a concern.
sentences.zh: 当7点15分过去后，伊莱恩还没出现在车站，希拉开始担心起来。

sentences.en: Calling her mobile phone resulted in no answer.
sentences.zh: 拨打她的手机无人接听。

sentences.en: Sheila left a message and waited.
sentences.zh: 希拉留了言，然后等待着。

sentences.en: Yet, Elaine never got back to her.
sentences.zh: 然而，伊莱恩始终没有回音。

sentences.en: Needing to get to work, Sheila hopped in her car and made the short drive across the road.
sentences.zh: 因为要赶去上班，希拉跳上车，开车穿过马路，路程很短。

sentences.en: Elaine's apartment was nestled within a shopping plaza on the northwestern suburban edge of Steppeside.
sentences.zh: 伊莱恩的公寓坐落在斯泰普赛德西北郊区的一个购物广场内。

sentences.en: The plaza housed a convenience store, pharmacy, dry cleaners, gym and a restaurant.
sentences.zh: 广场里有便利店、药店、干洗店、健身房和一家餐厅。

sentences.en: Sheila drove past the shops and headed to the surrounding apartment blocks.
sentences.zh: 希拉开车经过这些商店，前往周围的公寓楼。

sentences.en: Ringing the doorbell to Elaine's apartment was met with no response.
sentences.zh: 按响伊莱恩公寓的门铃，无人应答。

sentences.en: Sheila checked the time.
sentences.zh: 希拉看了看时间。

sentences.en: She was now at risk of running late for work and couldn't afford to wait around any longer.
sentences.zh: 她现在有上班迟到的风险，再也等不起了。

sentences.en: She decided to head off without Elaine.
sentences.zh: 她决定不等伊莱恩，先出发了。

sentences.en: Over an hour later, Elaine had yet to make contact.
sentences.zh: 一个多小时后，伊莱恩仍未联系她。

sentences.en: Sheila had no idea if her stepdaughter had made it to the Tall Ships Festival.
sentences.zh: 希拉不知道继女是否赶上了高桅帆船节。

sentences.en: Her niggling concern didn't subside, so Sheila notified her partner, Elaine's father, Frank O'Hara.
sentences.zh: 她心中那股挥之不去的担忧并未消退，于是希拉通知了她的伴侣，也就是伊莱恩的父亲弗兰克·奥哈拉（Frank O'Hara）。

sentences.en: Frank held little concern.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克并没有太担心。

sentences.en: He suspected Elaine must have slept through her morning alarm and woke up in a panic.
sentences.zh: 他怀疑伊莱恩一定是早上睡过头了，醒来时惊慌失措。

sentences.en: Not wanting to be late, she jumped straight into her car and rushed off to Dublin.
sentences.zh: 因为不想迟到，她直接跳上车匆忙赶往都柏林了。

sentences.en: She was probably too busy preparing for the festival to get in touch.
sentences.zh: 她可能正忙着为节日做准备，没空联系。

sentences.en: As the morning progressed, there was still no news from Elaine, so Frank O'Hara decided to visit his daughter's apartment.
sentences.zh: 随着上午过去，依然没有伊莱恩的消息，弗兰克·奥哈拉决定去女儿的公寓看看。

sentences.en: Using a spare key, he unlocked the front door and let himself in.
sentences.zh: 他用备用钥匙打开前门，走了进去。

sentences.en: Elaine wasn't home, and nothing inside appeared out of place.
sentences.zh: 伊莱恩不在家，屋里看起来一切正常。

sentences.en: But a dash of unease crossed his mind when he found her mobile phone.
sentences.zh: 但当他发现她的手机时，一丝不安涌上心头。

sentences.en: Elaine always had her phone on her, and had never left home without it.
sentences.zh: 伊莱恩总是随身带着手机，从没试过出门不带手机。

sentences.en: Maybe on this occasion, in the flurry and excitement for the festival, she accidentally left it behind.
sentences.zh: 也许这次是因为忙着准备节日，一时匆忙落下了。

sentences.en: Frank left the apartment, assuming Elaine would get in touch when she got back home later.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克离开了公寓，心想伊莱恩晚些时候回家就会联系他了。

sentences.en: That night, Sheila stood vigil, eyes transfixed on Elaine's apartment.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，希拉彻夜守候，目光紧盯着伊莱恩的公寓。

sentences.en: She waited for Elaine's car to pull up, a light to flicker on, her shadow to move past a window.
sentences.zh: 她等着伊莱恩的车开过来，等着灯光闪烁，等着她的身影从窗前掠过。

sentences.en: Night fell, and the apartment remained in darkness.
sentences.zh: 夜幕降临，公寓里依然一片漆黑。

sentences.en: No one came or went.
sentences.zh: 没有人进出。

sentences.en: Nothing stirred within.
sentences.zh: 屋里毫无动静。

sentences.en: At 11.30pm, Frank texted his daughter.
sentences.zh: 晚上11点30分，弗兰克给女儿发了条短信。

sentences.en: Masking his anxiety with a joke, he wrote,
sentences.zh: 他用玩笑掩饰内心的焦虑，写道：

sentences.en: Are you alive?
sentences.zh: “你还活着吗？”

sentences.en: Elaine didn't respond.
sentences.zh: 伊莱恩没有回复。

sentences.en: There was an extra reason for Frank O'Hara to celebrate St Patrick's Day, March 17, 1976.
sentences.zh: 对于弗兰克·奥哈拉来说，1976年3月17日的圣帕特里克节还有一个额外的庆祝理由。

sentences.en: His wife, Eileen, gave birth to their first child.
sentences.zh: 他的妻子艾琳（Eileen）生下了他们的第一个孩子。

sentences.en: A girl they named Elaine.
sentences.zh: 一个女孩，他们给她取名伊莱恩。

sentences.en: Elaine became the eldest of the four O'Hara children, including Anne, Frank Jr., and John.
sentences.zh: 伊莱恩是奥哈拉家四个孩子中的长女，其他孩子分别是安妮（Anne）、小弗兰克（Frank Jr.）和约翰（John）。

sentences.en: From Elaine's childhood onwards, she developed a close bond with her father that carried on into her adult life.
sentences.zh: 从童年起，伊莱恩就与父亲建立了深厚的感情，这种关系一直延续到她的成年生活。

sentences.en: Frank spoke to Elaine every day and saw her three or four times per week.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克每天都和伊莱恩通话，每周见她三四次。

sentences.en: He was, to her, a pillar of unwavering support.
sentences.zh: 对她而言，他是坚不可摧的后盾。

sentences.en: When Elaine failed to contact her father the entirety of August 23, 2012,
sentences.zh: 当伊莱恩在2012年8月23日全天都没有联系父亲时，

sentences.en: Frank knew something wasn't right.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克知道出事了。

sentences.en: Seeking answers, he revisited Elaine's apartment the following morning.
sentences.zh: 为了寻找答案，他第二天早上再次来到伊莱恩的公寓。

sentences.en: Everything inside the apartment was as it had been when Frank dropped in the day before.
sentences.zh: 公寓里的一切都和弗兰克前一天来时一模一样。

sentences.en: It didn't appear Elaine had come home throughout the night.
sentences.zh: 看起来伊莱恩整晚都没有回来。

sentences.en: However, something caught Frank's eye that he missed the first visit.
sentences.zh: 然而，弗兰克注意到了一些他第一次来时忽略的东西。

sentences.en: Elaine's handbag.
sentences.zh: 伊莱恩的手提包。

sentences.en: He knew it was unlikely Elaine left home for getting both her mobile phone and her handbag.
sentences.zh: 他知道伊莱恩不可能出门既不带手机也不带手提包。

sentences.en: Checking the apartment's underground parking garage,
sentences.zh: 检查了公寓的地下停车场后，

sentences.en: Frank saw her turquoise-coloured Fiat motor vehicle was missing.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克发现她那辆绿松石色的菲亚特汽车不见了。

sentences.en: Frank made inquiries with the tall ship's festival, only to discover Elaine never turned up.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克向高桅帆船节组委会询问，结果发现伊莱恩根本没去过。

sentences.en: There was only one other place Frank thought Elaine may have gone instead of the festival.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克认为，除了节日，伊莱恩可能去的地方只有一个。

sentences.en: He contacted Elaine's psychiatrist, Matt Murphy.
sentences.zh: 他联系了伊莱恩的精神科医生马特·墨菲（Matt Murphy）。

sentences.en: Recently, Elaine had been discharged from St. Edmundsbury Hospital after a six-week stay.
sentences.zh: 最近，伊莱恩在圣埃德蒙斯伯里医院（St. Edmundsbury Hospital）住了六周后刚刚出院。

sentences.en: Overwhelming financial pressures contributed to Elaine feeling overworked and highly stressed.
sentences.zh: 巨大的经济压力导致伊莱恩感到过度劳累，压力极大。

sentences.en: Having recently purchased her step-aside apartment, she struggled to keep up with payments and needed to have flood damage repaired.
sentences.zh: 由于刚买了这套公寓，她难以负担房贷，还需要修理水灾造成的损坏。

sentences.en: Described as having an incredible work ethic,
sentences.zh: 她被形容为有着令人难以置信的职业道德，

sentences.en: Elaine worked two jobs to keep on top of things.
sentences.zh: 伊莱恩打两份工来维持生计。

sentences.en: Elaine loved working with children and wanted to have her own one day.
sentences.zh: 伊莱恩热爱与孩子一起工作，并希望将来能有自己的孩子。

sentences.en: According to her father, she could relate to kids better than adults.
sentences.zh: 据她父亲说，她比成年人更能与孩子们相处。

sentences.en: Therefore, her work as a childcare worker at St. John's National School in Ballybrack gave her a sense of joy and accomplishment.
sentences.zh: 因此，她在巴利布拉克（Ballybrack）的圣约翰国立学校担任保育员的工作，让她感到快乐和成就感。

sentences.en: In addition to childcare,
sentences.zh: 除了保育工作，

sentences.en: Elaine worked as a shop assistant in a news agency in Black Rock.
sentences.zh: 伊莱恩还在黑石（Black Rock）的一家报刊亭做店员。

sentences.en: News agency owner Ken Robertson found Elaine to be a very honest person who was well-liked by customers.
sentences.zh: 报刊亭老板肯·罗伯逊（Ken Robertson）认为伊莱恩是一个非常诚实的人，深受顾客喜爱。

sentences.en: He trusted her, permitting her a set of keys to his shop.
sentences.zh: 他很信任她，甚至把店里的钥匙交给了她。

sentences.en: When Elaine asked to work as many hours that could be made available to her,
sentences.zh: 当伊莱恩要求尽可能多排班时，

sentences.en: Ken knew she was having financial probleMs.
sentences.zh: 肯就知道她遇到了经济困难。

sentences.en: On top of working two jobs,
sentences.zh: 除了打两份工，

sentences.en: Elaine also attended night school.
sentences.zh: 伊莱恩还参加了夜校。

sentences.en: Her goal was to follow in her mother Eileen's footsteps to become a primary school teacher.
sentences.zh: 她的目标是追随母亲艾琳的脚步，成为一名小学教师。

sentences.en: At the time, she was enrolled in a course to become a qualified Montessori teacher, a unique form of child education that deviates from traditional learning
sentences.zh: 当时，她正在修读一门课程，旨在成为一名合格的蒙台梭利教师，这是一种区别于传统学习的独特儿童教育形式，

sentences.en: and focuses on developing natural interests.
sentences.zh: 专注于培养孩子的天生兴趣。

sentences.en: Working two jobs, studying, as well as keeping on top of her pre-existing illnesses,
sentences.zh: 身兼两职、还要学习，同时还要应对原有的疾病，

sentences.en: Elaine struggled to cope.
sentences.zh: 伊莱恩感到难以承受。

sentences.en: In July 2012, she was contemplating suicide.
sentences.zh: 2012年7月，她曾萌生过自杀的念头。

sentences.en: Realising she needed help,
sentences.zh: 意识到自己需要帮助，

sentences.en: Elaine admitted herself to hospital for treatment.
sentences.zh: 伊莱恩住进医院接受治疗。

sentences.en: Frank O'Hara was surprised when Elaine checked herself in.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克·奥哈拉对伊莱恩主动入院感到惊讶。

sentences.en: He thought she'd been doing well lately.
sentences.zh: 他以为她最近状态不错。

sentences.en: It was her 14th stay in St Edmondsbury.
sentences.zh: 这是她第14次入住圣埃德蒙斯伯里医院。

sentences.en: Elaine had been in and out of hospital since the age of 16.
sentences.zh: 伊莱恩从16岁起就频繁出入医院。

sentences.en: The catalyst for her first visit in her mid-teens was the death of a close friend in a road accident.
sentences.zh: 她十几岁时第一次入院的导火索是一位好友在车祸中丧生。

sentences.en: Elaine was also bullied, causing her to withdraw and isolate herself.
sentences.zh: 伊莱恩还曾遭受霸凌，导致她退缩并自我孤立。

sentences.en: Masking the extent of her problems from her family,
sentences.zh: 为了向家人掩盖问题的严重性，

sentences.en: Elaine shouldered the burden alone, and at age 16, she attempted to take her own life.
sentences.zh: 伊莱恩独自承担了重负，并在16岁那年尝试自杀。

sentences.en: Her family were shattered, having failed to notice the signs.
sentences.zh: 她的家人心碎不已，因为他们没能及时发现迹象。

sentences.en: Elaine was admitted to St Edmondsbury Hospital, where she was treated by esteemed psychiatrist,
sentences.zh: 伊莱恩被送往圣埃德蒙斯伯里医院，由受人尊敬的精神科医生治疗，

sentences.en: Dr Anthony Clare.
sentences.zh: 安东尼·克莱尔医生（Dr. Anthony Clare）。

sentences.en: Initially,
sentences.zh: 起初，

sentences.en: Dr Clare was unsure what to diagnose Elaine with.
sentences.zh: 克莱尔医生不确定该如何诊断伊莱恩。

sentences.en: She had an inherent vulnerability,
sentences.zh: 她有一种与生俱来的脆弱感，

sentences.en: a childlike innocence, and a submissive personality.
sentences.zh: 一种孩子般的纯真，以及顺从的性格。

sentences.en: Her emotions were acute and strong compared to others.
sentences.zh: 与他人相比，她的情绪更为敏锐和强烈。

sentences.en: She would react more and take longer to return to a calm state.
sentences.zh: 她反应更激烈，恢复平静所需的时间也更长。

sentences.en: Elaine found it difficult to interact with people and believed she was constantly being judged by others.
sentences.zh: 伊莱恩觉得与人交往很困难，并认为自己总是受到他人的评判。

sentences.en: To some she befriended.
sentences.zh: 对于一些她结交的朋友来说，

sentences.en: Elaine was considered needy, high drama, and emotionally volatile, and eventually, her behaviour would cause the friendship to end.
sentences.zh: 伊莱恩被认为需要过度关注、爱演戏且情绪不稳定，最终，她的行为会导致友谊破裂。

sentences.en: She detailed that from age 12 onwards, she had intrusive thoughts, described as a play in her head, in which she was restrained, imprisoned, and punished.
sentences.zh: 她详细描述说，从12岁起，她就有侵入性的想法，就像脑子里在演戏一样，内容是她被束缚、囚禁和惩罚。

sentences.en: Dr Clare concluded these thoughts were an obsession for Elaine, and had manifested in what he noted as disturbing and masculine sexual fantasies.
sentences.zh: 克莱尔医生断定这些想法对伊莱恩来说是一种强迫症，并表现为他所记录的令人不安的男性化性幻想。

sentences.en: During his initial diagnosis,
sentences.zh: 在初步诊断期间，

sentences.en: Dr Clare considered Elaine was experiencing a gradually emerging psychosis, but later ruled it out.
sentences.zh: 克莱尔医生曾考虑伊莱恩是否出现了逐渐显现的精神病，但后来排除了这一可能。

sentences.en: Upon further consideration, he diagnosed her with borderline personality disorder and depression.
sentences.zh: 经过进一步考虑，他诊断她患有边缘性人格障碍和抑郁症。

sentences.en: He treated her with medication and tranquilisers.
sentences.zh: 他用药物和镇静剂对她进行治疗。

sentences.en: Frank and Dailene O'Hara visited their daughter often and took her out on Saturdays.
